name: Miniature Aetheryte
where: Grand Company quartermasters (Flame Quartermaster in Ul'dah, Serpent Quartermaster in New Gridania, Storm Quartermaster in Limsa Lominsa Upper Decks). Requires Second Lieutenant (Second Flame/Serpent/Storm Lieutenant) in the matching GC. Also tradeable, so the Market Board is an option.
purpose: Gives you a private teleport point to your estate's exterior entrance, so you never need the residential district aetheryte plaza.
placement: Outdoors (yard), near the front. Cannot be retrieved once placed (description), so choose the spot with care.
whoNeedsIt: Every owner; also lets tenants and FC members teleport home cheaply.
limits: One per estate. Outdoor Furnishing, counts toward the outdoor furnishing cap (cottage 40, house 60, mansion 80). Teleport to it costs 75% less, minimum 25 gil.
uncertain: The wiki page does not say whether the Seal price is per-GC identical (all three listed 14,470). Teleport discount text is from the wiki, not re-tested in game.

name: Summoning Bell
where: Crafted by Blacksmith (Lv 50; Wolfram Ingot, Ancient Lumber, Wildfowl Feather, 2 Fire Cluster, Earth Cluster) or bought on the Market Board.
purpose: Lets you call a retainer to your estate (same as the inn bell), no trip to a Retainer Vocate or inn needed.
placement: Indoors (Furnishing category). Also used to specify estate sizes when placing furnishings per wiki gallery notes.
whoNeedsIt: Anyone with retainers, which is nearly everyone.
limits: One per estate. Counts as an indoor furnishing. Not a vendor or facility.
uncertain: Crafted items are normally bought on the Market Board; no gil vendor price found, so price left blank.

name: Crystal Bell
where: Crafted by Blacksmith (Lv 60 Master Blacksmith III recipe book; Titanium Alloy Ingot, Birch Lumber, Wildfowl Feather, 2 Fire Cluster, Earth Cluster) or Market Board.
purpose: Summons the Aesthetician (Jandelaine) at home to change hairstyle, face, tattoos etc. Costs 2,000 gil or a Jandelaine's Token per accepted change.
whoNeedsIt: Anyone who changes appearance. The Aesthetician must be unlocked first with the level 15 quest Beauty Is Only Scalp Deep.
limits: One per estate. Counts as an indoor furnishing.
uncertain: Crafted items are normally bought on the Market Board; no gil vendor price found, so price left blank. Wiki says Aesthetician is unavailable from Norvrandt inns; housing availability is assumed fine.

name: Moogle Letter Box
where: Crafted by Armorer (Lv 45; Cobalt Plate, Mahogany Lumber, Undyed Woolen Cloth, Moggle Mog XII's Whisker, Ice Shard, Earth Shard), Market Board, or Keybound Coffer drops per wiki.
purpose: This is the housing 'mailbox': a Delivery Moogle at your front gate to send and receive letters and rewards.
whoNeedsIt: Players who use friend letters or Mog Station and reward deliveries.
limits: One per estate (Moogle OR Regal, they are the same function). Counts toward the outdoor furnishing cap.
uncertain: Crafted items are normally bought on the Market Board; no gil vendor price found, so price left blank. Mailbox naming: the in-game item is Letter Box, not Mailbox.

name: Regal Letter Box
where: Crafted by Goldsmith (Lv 50; Kingly Whisker, Gold Ingot, 4 Cobalt Plate, Ancient Lumber, 2 Undyed Woolen Cloth, Wind Cluster x2, Fire Cluster) or Market Board.
purpose: Fancier-looking alternative to the Moogle Letter Box; same Delivery Moogle service.
whoNeedsIt: Anyone preferring a nicer look.
limits: Shares the one-per-estate letter box slot with the Moogle Letter Box.
uncertain: Crafted items are normally bought on the Market Board; no gil vendor price found, so price left blank.

name: Chocobo Stable
where: Housing Merchant in each residential district (Mist, Lavender Beds, Goblet, Shirogane, Empyreum), or Market Board. A free stable already stands outside every Apartment Building.
purpose: Raise chocobos (Chocobo Raising) and change your companion's feather color; capacity 512.
whoNeedsIt: Anyone wanting to raise or recolor a chocobo at home. Apartment tenants can use the free one outside the building.
limits: One per estate. Outdoor furnishing slot. Stable can be used by tenants and FC members (stable and garden care is up to them).
uncertain: Variant stables (Glade, Oasis, Riviera, Oriental, Highland, Essentials; ids 15954, 15955, 15953, 17137, 35617, 38628) exist and are cosmetic-only per name; function not individually verified. Housing Merchant coordinates not repeated here.

name: Armoire
where: Crafted by Carpenter (Lv 50; Ebony Lumber, Wolfram Ingot, Varnish, Wind Cluster, Ice Cluster) or Market Board. An Armoire also exists in every inn room.
purpose: Infinite free storage for eligible special gear (event, achievement, artifact, newer dungeon gear), usable in Glamour Plates. Items lose dye.
whoNeedsIt: Everyone, especially those hoarding event or seasonal gear.
limits: One per estate. Counts as indoor furnishing. Unlike the Glamour Dresser, no prisms needed.
uncertain: Crafted items are normally bought on the Market Board; no gil vendor price found, so price left blank. Wiki notes the Glamour Dresser cannot be placed in any estate; Armoire is the only home storage of this kind.

name: Orchestrion
where: Crafted by Carpenter (Lv 60 Master Carpenter IV; Cassia Block, Birch Lumber, Rosewood Lumber, Gold Ingot, Scale Glue, Wind and Ice Cluster) or Market Board.
purpose: Plays any Orchestrion Roll song you own for everyone in the room, replacing area music.
placement: Indoors, floor-standing. Table Orchestrion (17954), Orchestrion Phonograph (35555) and Melodious Mogchestrion (21870, cash shop) are tabletop alternatives.
whoNeedsIt: Anyone wanting background music; the Orchestrion Log is unlocked by first use.
limits: One orchestrion of ANY type per estate. Playlist up to 8 songs. FC members and tenants need authorization to play or stop. Cannot be placed in a Company Workshop.
uncertain: Crafted items are normally bought on the Market Board; no gil vendor price found, so price left blank.

name: The Unending Journey
where: Crafted by Carpenter (Lv 58 Master Carpenter III), Market Board, or Keybound Coffer per wiki.
purpose: Rewatch cutscenes of quests you have completed.
whoNeedsIt: Anyone who wants to rewatch story cutscenes at home.
limits: One per estate.
uncertain: Crafted items are normally bought on the Market Board; no gil vendor price found, so price left blank.

name: Mannequin
where: Housing Merchant / Apartment Merchant in residential districts and apartment lobbies, or Estate Manservant/Maidservant (Steward) shops; see wiki vendor list.
purpose: Displays a gear set; also lets a retainer sell the gear via the Market Board from your estate.
placement: Indoors. Requires assigning a retainer as merchant when placing.
whoNeedsIt: Sellers and glamour fans. One retainer can serve multiple mannequins.
limits: Item text: apartments, cottages, houses, mansions hold 4, 6, 8, 10 'facilities'; wiki lists the same 4/6/8/10 as a mannequin limit.
uncertain: Item description says 'facilities' but numbers match the vendor cap (4/6/8/10), not the crafting facility cap (2/4/6/8). Unclear whether mannequins share the vendor cap. Verify in game before stating.

name: Mender Permit
where: Independent Sutler (General) in each residential district (Mist, Lavender Beds, Goblet, Shirogane, Empyreum) or Apartment Merchant in apartment lobbies.
purpose: Hires a Mender at home: repairs gear (to 100% durability only) for gil.
placement: Placed from the Housing menu like furniture, indoors or per vendor type; race/gender customizable on some.
whoNeedsIt: Everyone, saves trips to a city.
limits: Vendor cap per estate: apartment/private chamber 4, cottage 6, house 8, mansion 10. Shared across ALL vendor types.
uncertain: Mender repairs only to 100%; self-repair with Dark Matter goes to 199%.

name: Materia Melder Permit
where: Independent Sutler (General) in each residential district (Mist, Lavender Beds, Goblet, Shirogane, Empyreum) or Apartment Merchant in apartment lobbies.
purpose: Hires a Materia Melder at home: melds materia for gil.
placement: Placed from the Housing menu like furniture, indoors or per vendor type; race/gender customizable on some.
whoNeedsIt: Players melding materia.
limits: Vendor cap per estate: apartment/private chamber 4, cottage 6, house 8, mansion 10. Shared across ALL vendor types.
uncertain: Cannot perform overmelding per wiki.

name: Steward Permit
where: Independent Sutler (General) in each residential district (Mist, Lavender Beds, Goblet, Shirogane, Empyreum) or Apartment Merchant in apartment lobbies.
purpose: Hires an Estate Manservant or Maidservant who sells the same furnishings as a residential Housing Merchant.
placement: Placed from the Housing menu like furniture, indoors or per vendor type; race/gender customizable on some.
whoNeedsIt: Decorators.
limits: Vendor cap per estate: apartment/private chamber 4, cottage 6, house 8, mansion 10. Shared across ALL vendor types.
uncertain: Handy for buying furnishing and facility items without leaving home.

name: Junkmonger Permit
where: Independent Sutler (General) in each residential district (Mist, Lavender Beds, Goblet, Shirogane, Empyreum) or Apartment Merchant in apartment lobbies.
purpose: Hires a Junkmonger: cheap dyes, Dark Matter, garden patches, Magicked Stable Broom.
placement: Placed from the Housing menu like furniture, indoors or per vendor type; race/gender customizable on some.
whoNeedsIt: Gardeners and anyone repairing with Dark Matter.
limits: Vendor cap per estate: apartment/private chamber 4, cottage 6, house 8, mansion 10. Shared across ALL vendor types.
uncertain: Several cosmetic variants exist (A-2, A-3, beast tribe versions) with the same function.

name: Material Supplier Permit
where: Independent Sutler (General) in each residential district (Mist, Lavender Beds, Goblet, Shirogane, Empyreum) or Apartment Merchant in apartment lobbies.
purpose: Hires a Material Supplier selling low-level ARR crafting ingredients.
placement: Placed from the Housing menu like furniture, indoors or per vendor type; race/gender customizable on some.
whoNeedsIt: Leveling crafters.
limits: Vendor cap per estate: apartment/private chamber 4, cottage 6, house 8, mansion 10. Shared across ALL vendor types.
uncertain: Low-level only.

name: Journeyman Salvager Permit
where: Independent Sutler (General) in each residential district (Mist, Lavender Beds, Goblet, Shirogane, Empyreum) or Apartment Merchant in apartment lobbies.
purpose: Hires a Journeyman Salvager (the housing Calamity Salvager equivalent) to rebuy quest or achievement reward items for a small gil fee.
placement: Placed from the Housing menu like furniture, indoors or per vendor type; race/gender customizable on some.
whoNeedsIt: Anyone who lost quest or achievement items.
limits: Vendor cap per estate: apartment/private chamber 4, cottage 6, house 8, mansion 10. Shared across ALL vendor types.
uncertain: Wiki equates it with Calamity Salvager. Not a plain 'Calamity Salvager' permit name.

name: Woodworking Bench
where: Crafted (recipe seen for Woodworking Bench: Carpenter Lv 50) or Market Board. Each facility matches the Carpenter class.
purpose: Interact while on the matching crafter to get a 30-minute buff that temporarily raises max CP at crafter level 90 or below (no effect above). The wiki says +10 CP.
whoNeedsIt: Anyone leveling Carpenter at home.
limits: Crafting facility cap per estate: apartment/private chamber 2, cottage 4, house 6, mansion 8. Usable by owner and tenants in a personal house, any member in an FC house.
uncertain: Crafted items are normally bought on the Market Board; no gil vendor price found, so price left blank. Wiki and item text differ slightly in wording (CP amount only on wiki); crafting recipe details verified for Smithing/Woodworking/Cooking pages only; other recipes not individually checked.
